limitations: Analytic formulas are evaluated in float64; no interval-certified eigenvalue or invariant solve.
Residual alone is not a rigorous finite-chain invariant numerical error bound; sparse arithmetic excluded from analytic cap allowance.
Conditional lattice modes require supported exact y and finite marginal mass; mode-weight cap bound is disclosed separately.
Full stationary sampling, discrete retained-node law and representative-bin policies are different targets; quadrature bias requires independent allowance or same-law comparison.
IID Monte Carlo SE excludes cap/invariant/policy/quadrature numerical errors.
Policy information restrictions, oracle optimality and strict gap tie rules remain caller responsibilities; supplied policies never inferred from realized future.
Geometric-run integration uses double-precision arithmetic; no epsilon-based action decisions occur in this module.
Stationary full queue law is an audit target only, not adoption of v1.3 contract; no engine verification or hypothesis conclusion follows from unit tests.

math_review.lyapunov: K=diag(exp(theta*d))*P; reflection correction bounded at q0; stationary mode marginal 1/2; zero-start coupling plus overflow union bound
math_review.cost_allowance: cost<=B0+h*(yA+yB); monotone initial coupling, mismatch truncation and exponential excess moment control for unbounded backlog costs
math_review.c2_no_idle_proof: For d=max(0,mu-(lambda_bg-6)-min(vStay,vSwitch)), q_current>=H*dt*d implies both unreflected endpoint backlogs >=q_current-k*dt*d>=0 for every k<=H and every mode path. Reflection is inactive, including a zero endpoint. Thus qSwitch[k]-qStay[k]=k*dt*(vSwitch-vStay), and D13 gap=(vSwitch-vStay)*dt^2*H*(H+1)/2. Parameters and dt are Fraction rationals; final gap converts once. The backlog threshold is rounded upward only when needed to the least float >=exact rational threshold, so comparison has no epsilon or false positive from downward threshold rounding. Current float q is treated exactly; previous age arithmetic uncertainty is not certified.
